description.value: Mama Panda is a Chinese restaurant located in Fort St. John, BC, serving the northeastern corner of the province. Fort St. John sits along the Alaska Highway and is a key service stop for cyclists touring through the Peace River region. The restaurant offers a sit-down dining option in a community that sees long distances between food stops.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content returned is almost entirely a cookie-consent/GDPR banner with no substantive restaurant information, so OSM tags are the primary evidence source. OSM confirms an active Chinese restaurant at 9608 100 Street, Fort St. John, with phone and website matching. No amenity details (bike parking, washrooms, takeout, Wi-Fi, etc.) can be confirmed from either source.
concerns: Website content only returned a cookie-consent/GDPR banner (3,547 bytes); no substantive restaurant information was extractable. All amenity fields remain null as a result.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active Chinese restaurant in Fort St. John confirmed by OSM tags; no indication of closure or phantom listing.
